failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Which band recorded the album "Shapes"?' — a natural-language yes/no question format. Hop 3 query: 'Which American rock band from Chapel Hill, North Carolina recorded the album "Shapes"?' — again a natural-language question rather than a keyword-based or entity-targeted retrieval query.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query asks 'Which band recorded the album "Shapes"?' and retrieves passages about albums with 'shape' in the title but no album called 'Shapes'. Hop 3 query asks 'Which American rock band from Chapel Hill, North Carolina recorded the album "Shapes"?' — essentially the same question with geographic constraint added, resulting in retrieval of the same Chapel Hill bands from hop 1 plus albums with 'shape' from hop 2. No substantive advancement in search strategy despite summary guidance that a passage about 'the album Shapes' was needed.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: Summary 1: 'evidence documents would be needed that: (1) identify which band recorded the album "Shapes"'. Summary 2: 'A passage about the album "Shapes" that explicitly names which band recorded it'. Hop 2 query: 'Which band recorded the album "Shapes"?' Hop 3 query: 'Which American rock band from Chapel Hill, North Carolina recorded the album "Shapes"?' Despite well-formed entity targeting (the album 'Shapes'), no passage about this album was retrieved across three hops.
